title: Current product already has meaningful commercial value
statement: Mesa, Prospecção, Call AI, Comunicação, Sales Brain, ROI/quotation and Excel-related workflows are assets to preserve rather than reasons for a full rewrite.
evidence_summary: Audit/plan identify existing commercial modules as assets to preserve.

title: Foundation reliability was the primary structural gap
statement: The primary gap was not feature count but reliable source of truth, canonical identity, individual identity, synchronization/conflict, restore/backup, observability and critical tests.
evidence_summary: Audit and gap analysis converge on foundation reliability as primary structural gap.

title: Package 01 left canonical data and auth disabled
statement: Package 01 was additive; canonical data and authentication paths remain disabled by default and commercial data was not migrated.
evidence_summary: Package 01 report confirms feature flags leave canonical/auth paths disabled by default.
